The Young Professionals Program (YPP), Asian Development Bank

Another YPP program at ADB. YPs will be posted in ADB HQ in Manila. Applications close on October, 7.

To be eligible for the ADB Young Professionals Program, you must:

Be a national of an ADB member country.
Be 32 years old and below.
Hold at least a first-level university degree with proven academic track record in a field relevant to the job role.
Have at least three years of work experience relevant to ADB.
Be passionate and committed to development work.
Be a keen and agile learner with strong interpersonal skills.
Have excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

https://www.adb.org/work-with-us/careers/adb-young-professionals-program
Asian Development Bank
ADB Young Professionals Program (YPP)
ADB's Young Professionals Program (YPP) recruits highly qualified and motivated individuals to ADB. YPP provides the foundation for a challenging and rewarding professional career in an international development environment.
